shared_elements: schematic standing anthropomorphic form or torso
arms/hands indicated along the sides of the body
circular disc-like motifs on the body/surface

justification: The strongest correspondence is that both surfaces present a schematic upright anthropomorphic body-like form with side arms and some circular and banded motifs on the front. The biggest difference is that B is dominated by multiple profile animals and register-like emblematic carvings, while A is mainly a single frontal human/creature body with breasts, navel, face-like features, and abdominal bands.
